note: Canonical host/evaluator vocabulary. Prefer these IDs over inventing synonyms. Cross-link DOCTRINE, HOST_EVAL, VALIDATION, SCENE_INTELLIGENCE.

PLAYER_FIRST.definition: Explicit player-directed queue or command outranks autonomy, host suggestions, and optimization.

QUEUE_OBSERVATION.definition: Operator- or sensor-attested list of current/pending Sim interactions (ids/labels only). Not a Sims API hook.

GOOD_BEHAVIOR.definition: Queued action class that advances the highest-urgency unmet need (or preserves player direction) without forbidden save/resume actions.

BAD_BEHAVIOR.definition: Queued action that neglects critical motives, thrash-walks in-frame, or prefers fluff (read/skill/whim) over bladder/hunger/energy when those are critical.

EMULATE.definition: Reproduce the same intent class as the observed good queue (e.g. eat→eat). Does not invent new goals. May still route better under OPTIMIZE_ROUTING.

OPTIMIZE.definition: Replace or reorder a bad or suboptimal queue toward critical-need recovery using durable host transitions (map travel, cancel fluff). Never optimizes away player direction.

EMULATE_THEN_OPTIMIZE.definition: Keep the good intent, but change routing/latency (e.g. Manage Worlds / phone travel home instead of in-frame walk thrash).

IN_FRAME_WALK_THRASH.definition: Host failure mode: clicking distant same-lot objects so the Sim pathfinds endlessly within the PrintWindow frame. Forbidden when a map/travel transition reaches the lot that has the required object.

MAP_TRAVEL.definition: Host transition via Manage Worlds pin or phone travel to the destination lot, then Live object interaction. Preferred over IN_FRAME_WALK_THRASH for off-lot or missing-object critical recovery.

HOST_LISTENER.definition: Opt-in, bounded session that accepts queue/needs observations and runs host evaluators. Inactive until the operator activates it. Not a background daemon or GHA job.

HOST_EVALUATOR.definition: Read-only deterministic scorer over supplied observations (host_eval, instincts_host, behavior_eval, decision_eval). Does not click the game.

PROGRESSION_EVALUATOR.definition: Repository eval framework scoring vision markers, CI scaffolding, and GAME_CERTIFIED product progression rate. Offline green never raises product_progression_rate.

OUTDOOR_SOCIAL_DEFAULT.definition: Hosted-event failure mode: social interactions walk Sims outdoors (sidewalk/umbrella) while indoor venue capacity remains free.

EVENT_INDOOR_ROUTING.definition: Call-stack gate that cancels outdoor social prefix and grounds conversation indoors, preferring Sit and Chat Here before weaker Go Here / greet retargets.

SIT_AND_CHAT_HERE.definition: Sit and Chat Here: indoor seat pie-menu interaction that seats conversational partners and starts chat in place, preventing outdoor meetup re-routing.

SIT_AND_CHAT_HERE_INDOOR.definition: Preferred EVENT_INDOOR_ROUTING host route: click indoor sofa/chair/bench → Sit and Chat Here (locale-equivalent).

EVENT_BALANCE_STACK.definition: Host priority stack balancing player, viewport, survival needs, indoor routing, event goals, Fun-via-goals, homework, then other needs.

EVENT_GOAL_ACTION.definition: Concrete pie-menu or object interaction catalogued as satisfying a social-event HUD goal.

EVENT_GOAL_PLAN.definition: Host plan that maps incomplete event goals to prioritized indoor satisfying interactions and queue coverage.

FUN_SERVICE.definition: Independent Fun-need host evaluator with parallel activity lanes; peer to event/school services, not a monolith queue tail.

FUN_LANE.definition: One Fun activity family (portable, electronics, creative, playful, child) planned as its own service so Sims avoid piling onto contended objects.

FUN_CONTENTION.definition: Guests or sibling Sims occupy shared Fun objects; host prefers personal_portable and other free lanes.

NEED_SERVICES_TANDEM.definition: Host gate that plans hunger/bladder/energy/hygiene/fun/social as independent services in parallel and picks the primary READY need by motive urgency.

NEED_SERVICE_BASE.definition: P124 shared helpers (normalize needs, object freeness, lane planner) that every need service must reuse instead of reinventing parsers.

NEED_LANES.definition: Lane catalogs for non-Fun motives (hunger, bladder, energy, hygiene, social); Fun keeps contracts/fun-service.v1.json.

NEED_SERVICE_HEALTH.definition: Per-microsystem probe result HEALTHY, DEGRADED, UNHEALTHY, or YIELDED used by need load balance.

NEED_SERVICE_DETACH.definition: Remove an unhealthy need microsystem from the primary selection pool and abandon its sticky call stack.

ASSUMPTION_WINDOW.definition: Fresh exploration frame after detach: scene reset, cleared sticky assumptions, and reweighted alternate options for that need avenue.

NEED_LOAD_BALANCE.definition: Host orchestration that health-checks tandem need services, detaches unhealthy stacks, opens assumption windows, and picks primary among healthy READY siblings.

DOMAIN_CASCADE.definition: Ordered poll bus that emits cascading receipts across needs (with LB), budget, career, skills/whims, and relationships on each observation — not a background daemon.

MOODLET_STRIP.definition: Bottom-left Sim emotion and moodlet icons. Host logic requires supplied labels; absence is SENSOR_NOT_SUPPLIED.

MOODLET_AWARE_ROUTING.definition: Call-stack gate that folds tense/uncomfortable moodlets into indoor retarget and survival-aligned relief.

SIM_PROFILE_INSPECT.definition: Read-only gate that normalizes supplied Simology/skills/preferences/whims with moodlets. Never practice_skill or BI-005.

SIMOLOGY_PANEL.definition: Live Sim Info Simology surface for traits and aspiration. Distinct from host-menu select_sim_to_play and compatibility patch profiles.

PLAYER_DISCOVERY_MAP.definition: Documented HUD locations where a player can inspect moodlets, whims, Simology, skills, and likes/dislikes for the active Sim.

PROOF_CEILING.definition: Explicit maximum claim allowed for an artifact (e.g. OFFLINE, LOCAL_OBSERVED, NOT_LIVE_CERT).

LOCAL_OBSERVED.definition: Observed on a real local game session with capture/receipt; not GAME_CERTIFIED and not CI-substitutable.

GAME_CERTIFIED.definition: Maintainer-accepted live certification for an exact patch/module after BI-002 gates. Offline green never grants this.

PLAYER_PRESENT_ON_CANVAS.definition: Foreground window is the Sims client AND cursor lies inside the game client rectangle.

PLAYER_PLAYING.definition: Operator is actively playing: on-canvas presence, recent input within grace, operator-declared playing, or player-directed queue. Host must YIELD_TO_PLAYER.

HOST_MAY_AUTOMATE.definition: Opt-in session is ACTIVE, presence is not PLAYER_PLAYING, and probe succeeded. Host may evaluate and, only with explicit --execute, SendInput.

YIELD_TO_PLAYER.definition: Host refuses SendInput and does not rewrite the queue because the player is playing or presence is unknown.

HOST_AUTOMATE.definition: Presence-gated orchestrator that runs behavior_eval + host_stack + needs_force plans when HOST_MAY_AUTOMATE; never a default background daemon.

HOUSEHOLD_FUNDS.definition: Observed or operator-supplied Simoleon balance for the active disposable household. Host money-stat input; not a save-file edit.

FEDERAL_SUBSIDY_PROMPT.definition: When funds are below 100, host shows a Sims-styled HOUSEHOLD NOTICE offering a Simolean federal bank boost; Yes runs durable funds inject.

FUNDS_INJECT.definition: Mode-agnostic cheat sequence: Ctrl+Shift+C → testingcheats enabled true → Money N (best-effort) → motherlode chunks. Never force F1; never claimed as BI-004 earned income.

TESTINGCHEATS_ENABLED_TRUE.definition: Required console activation command before Money inject. Skipping it is a known live failure mode.

CHEAT_CONSOLE_CHORD.definition: Ctrl+Shift+C opens the Sims cheat console on PC in Live, Build, or Buy. Host funds inject must press this chord before testingcheats/Money/motherlode — never skip, never force F1 to open it.

MODE_AGNOSTIC_FUNDS_INJECT.definition: Funds inject that preserves the operator's current mode (Live/Build/Buy); never forces F1 or Esc-spam while they build.

EARN_INCOME_CRITICAL.definition: Money-stat urgency when funds are desperate; earn path is never suppressed by purchase lockdown.

HOST_CRISIS_ANTI_PATTERN.definition: School Join (or leaving home) while needs/funds are critical — stranded the lab off-lot; Send Alone is mandatory.

LOT_ENVIRONMENT_GAIN.definition: Build/Buy item stat that raises room Environment Score toward Decorated / Beautifully Decorated Happy moodlets; stacks per wall panel.

ECO_FOOTPRINT_GREEN.definition: Eco Lifestyle lot contribution toward neighborhood Clean Air / green utopia moodlets; mutually exclusive maximize objective vs industrial.

ECO_FOOTPRINT_INDUSTRIAL.definition: Eco Lifestyle lot contribution toward smog / Gross Air; opt-in storytelling maximize only — excluded from green/balanced household defaults.

BUILD_OPTIMIZE_PLAN.definition: Evaluate-only ranked Build/Buy catalog receipt for a stated objective; execute_allowed stays false until disposable Build Mode P08 proof.

SCHOOL_DAY_GOAL_PROGRESS.definition: Host gate that queues incomplete High School Years top-left school-day HUD goals when needs are not survival-critical.

HOMEWORK_PREMISES_BLOCKED.definition: Career-panel homework is deferred while the Sim is on school premises or an active school day.

SURVIVAL_BEFORE_HOMEWORK.definition: Teen hunger/bladder/energy below threshold outrank career-panel homework queueing.

HOMEWORK_INVENTORY_MISSING.definition: Teen homework daily task remains due but supplied inventory_has_homework=false triggers recovery ladder; lot-scan Put in Inventory outranks computer recovery unless homework_on_lot=false.

LOT_SCAN_PUT_HOMEWORK_IN_INVENTORY.definition: Host recovery route: scan current-lot surfaces for the homework book, click it, Put in Inventory, then queue do-homework.

SOCIAL_LOOKUP_REQUIRED.definition: Invite-over dialog active; host must uniquely look up invitee in Sims library before OK.

SOCIAL_OPPORTUNITY_OK_ALLOWED.definition: Unique Sims-library match with allowlisted occult status; app may press OK.

CAMERA_LOT_IS_NOT_SIM_PREMISES.definition: Viewport/camera lot differs from active Sim premises; sim_at_school/effective_location_kind drive homework gates.

QUEUE_TEEN_HOMEWORK.definition: Queue DO_HOMEWORK / WORK_ON_HOMEWORK when teen inventory_has_homework=true at home.

HOMEWORK_AFTER_NEEDS_QUEUE.definition: Finish toilet/shower/eat queue items before teen homework when survival is green.

PINNED_WHIM_SEDENTARY.definition: Pinned Not Stumble prefers sedentary stumble_safe school actions such as Study for Exams.

SCENARIO_GOAL_PROGRESS.definition: Host gate that queues incomplete scenario scoring HUD goals when survival needs are green and school day does not outrank.

SCENARIO_CAREER_DEFERRED.definition: Scenario get_career goal is blocked until allow_career, needs_game_certified, and income_game_observed; earn/craft precede career.

NAVIGATING_NEEDS_TANDEM.definition: Host gate that queues Discovery Quest Navigating Needs panel goals aligned to linked motives by urgency, instead of inventing parallel need fluff.

URGENT_NEED_WITHOUT_PANEL_GOAL.definition: An urgent motive is not covered by currently incomplete Navigating Needs panel goals; fall through to need_services (then instincts) rather than waiting on a non-visible discovery goal.

BUILD_OR_BUY_YIELD.definition: Host abstains from Navigating Needs / needs-object clicks while Build or Buy mode is active; never force Live (F1) on the operator.

CURIOUS_CATALOG.definition: Opt-in immersive chance-card workflow for hidden Buy rare/money gardening objects via bb.showhiddenobjects. Never autoruns; never touches game speed; never types buydebug.

SHOW_HIDDEN_OBJECTS.definition: Durable console line bb.showhiddenobjects (buydebug is a nickname only). Requires testingcheats first; one command per line.
